elevate.move: Make the hero the forecast itself: h1 on the lake naming trade + city, and the three drift bands sweep across the map during the intro and settle over town pins labelled with the house type and weak spot each band hits, so the map is a legend read in 3 seconds and the next pinned band peeks below.

Turn photography into part of the signature: one street plate per neighbourhood (city frame, Tipp Hill clapboard, Liverpool colonial) clipped to its pin at each zoom-story step, all in one shared snow/lake-blue grade, so the photos tell the county-to-street sequence.
